Treatment consists of screening, aerated grit removal, primary sedimentation...
primary sedimentation by circular and rectangular clarifiers
biological treatment by trickling filters followed by activated sludge aeration basins
disinfection by chlorination, and dechlorination by sodium bisulfite
all stormwater at the plant and pump stations is collected and directed to the plant’s headworks for treatment
